in_sanskrit.name: Vijayaraja
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Vijayaraja is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Vijaya' meaning victory and 'Raja' meaning king. It is a name that evokes the image of a powerful and victorious ruler.

in_hindi.name: विजयराज
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Vijayaraja in Hindi translates to 'Vijayi Raja', which means 'Victorious King'. This name is a tribute to the strength and power of a victorious monarch.

in_tamil.name: ராஜேச்கரன்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Rajasekaran in Tamil translates to 'Rajas Ekaraan', which means 'Lord of Victory'. This name is a symbol of triumph and victory, inspiring confidence and courage.

in_telugu.name: రాజేశ్కరన్
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Rajasekaran in Telugu translates to 'Rajasheshkaran', which means 'Lord of Victory'. This name is a reminder of the power and might of the victorious king.
